allow: PowerShell(Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\Local Sites\\dimsop-theme\\app\\public\\wp-content\\themes" | Select-Object Name, LinkType, Target; Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\\Local Sites\\dimsop-theme\\app\\public\\wp-content\\plugins" | Select-Object Name)

PowerShell(npm --prefix .. run build 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 5; $j = Get-Content "$env:APPDATA\\Local\\sites.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $j.PSObject.Properties | ForEach-Object { $_.Value | Select-Object name, domain, path, @{n='http';e={$_.services.nginx.ports.HTTP}}, @{n='mailpit';e={$_.services.mailpit.ports}} })

PowerShell($j = Get-Content "$env:APPDATA\\Local\\sites.json" -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $s=$j.PSObject.Properties | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty Value; $s.services.mysql | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; $s.mysql | ConvertTo-Json -Compress; Get-ChildItem "$env:APPDATA\\..\\Local\\Programs\\Local\\resources\\extraResources\\lightning-services" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name; Get-ChildItem "C:\\Program Files\\Local\\resources\\extraResources\\lightning-services" -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name)

PowerShell($my = Get-ChildItem "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Programs\\Local\\resources\\extraResources\\lightning-services\\mysql-8.4.0+2" -Recurse -Filter mysql.exe | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName; & $my -h 127.0.0.1 -P 10005 -u root -proot local -e "SELECT option_name, LEFT\(option_value,200\) v FROM wp_options WHERE option_name IN \('siteurl','permalink_structure','timezone_string','gmt_offset','WPLANG','date_format','blogname','blogdescription','show_on_front','page_on_front','page_for_posts','template','stylesheet','active_plugins','wp_mail_smtp','start_of_week'\)" 2>$null)
